name: pulse
description: Pulse: one `pulse:workflow` workflow router plus standalone utility skills for planned, validated, reviewable software delivery

interface.shortDescription: One `pulse:workflow` router plus standalone utility skills
interface.longDescription: Packages one user-facing `pulse:workflow` guidance router for session entry, planning, validation, execution, review, and follow-up, plus standalone utility skills outside that router. Mutable graph and daemon runtime operations belong to the Rust `pulse` CLI and daemon.
defaultPrompt: Use `pulse:workflow plan` and `pulse:workflow validate` before execution.
Use `pulse:workflow review` after execution is complete.
